items.text: The American Space Agency’s Solar Dynamic Observatory snaps a photo of the sun every 12 seconds in ten wavelengths of invisible ultraviolet light. Each wavelength helps highlight a different temperature of solar material and each is assigned a colour. In the project named ’ Thermonuclear Art’, a team pieced together the video from the individual pictures. It took a team of specialists about ten hours to produce one minute of footage. You can see solar flares , vast explosions of material bursting out of the Sun’s surface, and coronal loops – this is solar material streaming up and down the lines of the Sun’s magnetic field. Recently, NASA also released a video of Jupiter in 4K , showing changes in the planet’s Giant Red Spot. Difficult words: snap (take), assign (give), thermonuclear (relating to nuclear reactions which happen on the sun), solar flare (a brief eruption of intense high-energy radiation from the sun’s), vast (large), 4K (very high quality video). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

NASA released a new HD video of the sun, and it calls it “ thermonuclear art”. A telescope took a picture of the sun every 12 seconds in ten wavelengths of light. Then, people put these images together to create a video. It took the NASA team about ten hours to produce one minute of the video. NASA also recently released footage of Jupiter in 4K HD. It shows changes in the planet’s Giant Red Spot. Difficult words: thermonuclear (relating to nuclear reactions which happen on the sun), telescope (a thing for watching things which are very far away), wavelength (type). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A telescope takes pictures of the sun. It takes a picture every 12 seconds. NASA takes these images. It puts them together. This takes a long time, but the pictures make a video. This video is in HD . There is also a video of Jupiter. It is in 4K . Difficult words: telescope (a thing for watching things which are very far away), HD (high-definition – video that looks very good), 4K (video that looks even better than HD). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The South African government plans to end recurring power cuts, but it could take at least a year for any changes. The state energy utility Eskom is struggling. It implemented large power cuts last week, and it’s scheduled to do the cuts again this week. In July, President Cyril Ramaphosa promised new measures to solve the crisis; however, Eskom’s senior official said that despite the various plans, the measures will take time to implement. Eskom’s fleet of coal-fired power stations are aging and unreliable, and the situation brings problems for Africa’s most industrialized economy. 42 generating units, or almost 24,000 megawatts of capacity, failed last week, and some electricity facilities broke down more than once. So far this year, Eskom has spent 451 million dollars on diesel to run emergency generators. Difficult words: recurring (happening repeatedly), implement (to start a complicated process), fleet (a number of vehicles or facilities that operate together, or they belong to the same owner). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

South Africa is struggling with regular power cuts , and the government’s plans aren’t working to help the problem. Last week, many power cuts happened, which had a big impact on Africa’s most industrialized country. 42 power stations had problems, and some power stations stopped working more than only once. Eskom, the country’s energy company, promised to solve the crisis, but its officials said that the solution would take at least a year. Eskom’s power stations are getting old and causing many problems. This year, the company already spent 451 million dollars on diesel for emergency generators . Difficult words: power cut (a period of time when no electricity is in an area), industrialized (many businesses and factories), generator (a machine which makes electricity). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

South Africa has the biggest economy on the African continent. The country needs a lot of electricity. The situation is a problem for Eskom. Eskom is an energy company. It is a government company. It has many power stations across the country. They are getting old. They don’t work well. Regularly , something breaks. Power cuts happen. A power cut turns off electricity for some time. Last week, many power cuts happen. 42 power stations have problems. Officials promise to change the situation. They have plans on what to do. Eskom says that it can take at least one year before the situation is better. Difficult words: economy (many companies or people who buy and sell things and services), power station (a factory which makes electricity), regularly (when something repeats). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

To attract Gen Z , Japanese liquor businesses have turned to non-alcoholic beverages. In Tokyo, the newly opened Sumadori Bar offers mocktails or cocktails with low alcohol levels to 3%. The Japanese giant Asahi Group manages the bar, and it aims to provide an environment where both drinkers and teetotalers can enjoy a drink together. The popularity of low and non-alcoholic beverages has risen worldwide, particularly during the health crisis, as many people became more health conscious. Drinking patterns in Japan have changed, and the older generation tends to drink less alcohol. The culture used to be that when a company hired a person, he or she drank with senior colleagues. However, fewer opportunities exist now, and often, it’s not even possible. Over the summer, Japan’s tax office launched a contest to ask for ideas on how to stimulate the young people’s demand for alcohol; however, Gen Z seems to prefer non-alcoholic options. Difficult words: Gen Z (people born between the late 1990s and the early 2010s), teetotaler (a person who doesn’t drink alcohol), stimulate (to encourage). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In Japan, drinking patterns are changing, and people are drinking much less alcohol than in the past. The Japanese company Asahi Group recently opened a bar in Tokyo, and it offers cocktails with no or very little alcohol. During the pandemic, the popularity of non-alcoholic drinks grew in all the world. People couldn’t go to pubs and bars, so they looked after their health more. In Japan, workers used to go to bars to drink after work, but this situation doesn’t happen so much anymore. Also, young people prefer to drink non-alcoholic beverages . Companies must react to these changes, so they are offering many more non-alcoholic options than in the past. The Japanese government is looking for ways to make young people drink more alcohol, but the situation is difficult because alcoholic drinks are not very popular among them. Difficult words: pattern (a regular way to do something), beverage (a drink other than water), option (a thing which someone can choose). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In the past in Japan, people usually take other workers to a bar. They drink alcohol together. Young people don’t do this activity anymore. The coronavirus changes everything. People can’t go to pubs and bars. They look after their health more. They don’t drink less alcohol. They prefer non-alcoholic drinks. This trend happens in all the world. It happens especially among young people. The sales are growing for non-alcoholic drinks. Japanese bars now offer many non-alcoholic drinks. The government wants young people to drink more alcohol. The situation is not easy. Young people have a different lifestyle than older people. Difficult words: non-alcoholic (with no alcohol), trend (a normal situation or activity), lifestyle (how people live). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

According to data, US companies ordered a record-setting 12,305 robot machines in the beginning of 2022. The number is 25% more than the same period a year ago. The pandemic highlighted some areas where shortages and resources needed automation . Companies had to automate because people weren’t coming back to the workplace, and they needed other options. For a long time, the automotive industry accounted for 60-70% of robot orders, but then other industries followed. E-commerce companies were particularly interested in robots; they can grab and transport packages quickly. Robots help do the tasks that businesses need; however, robots need time to produce and to set up their operation. A human workforce with specialized training needs to install, maintain, and operate programs. The lack of training is currently the biggest barrier in the further adoption of robotics. Difficult words: automation (the completion of work with machines or computers), barrier (an obstacle that keeps things from moving or improving), adoption (the beginning to use something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

US companies buy more robots than ever. In the second quarter of 2022, they bought 25% more robots than in the same time last year. During the coronavirus, the need for robots grew a lot. Many workers stayed at home, and companies had to make things without people. Before the coronavirus, most robots worked in the car industry, but the situation changed in recent years. E-commerce companies are buying many robots because they work fast, and they manipulate packages easily. One problem with robots is that it takes time to make them. Robots do people’s work, but workers must operate them. People must learn to make robots do the right tasks. Difficult words: quarter (a time of three months), manipulate (to use a tool or machine), operate (to control a machine or system). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Companies use more and more robots. In the US, companies buy more robots than last year. Robots make people’s work easier. They work faster. They do tasks which are too hard for people. In the past, robots work mainly in the car business. The situation changes during the coronavirus. Many workers stay at home. Companies don’t have enough workers. Companies buy robots. Now many robots work for e-commerce companies. They can move packages quickly and easily. Companies want to use even more robots. People must control them. They need more people. Before companies buy more robots, workers must learn about them. Difficult words: task (work that a person or machine must do), e-commerce (the business to buy or sell things online), package (a thing in a box). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Near Dmanisi, Georgia, archaeologists unearthed a 1.8-million-year-old tooth which belongs to an early species of human. In the late 1990s and early 2000s, other archaeologists found human skulls dated to the same time near Dmanisi. The discoveries are the oldest in the world outside Africa. The oldest Homo Sapien fossils date to around 2.8 million years ago, found in modern-day Ethiopia. Experts say that the Dmanisi finds cement the region as the home of one of the earliest prehistoric human settlements in Europe, possibly anywhere outside Africa. The implications are enormous for Georgia and for the story of humans leaving Africa 1.8 million years ago. The research extends human occupation of the area, and it solidifies Georgia as an important place for paleoanthropology and the story of humans. Difficult words: cement (to establish firmly), solidify (to make something stronger or more certain), paleoanthropology (the study of the origins and development of early humans). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Archaeologists in Dmanisi, Georgia, found a very old tooth. The tooth belonged to a human who lived 1.8 million years ago. Dmanisi was also where people found very old human skulls that were as old as the tooth. These finds were the oldest outside Africa, which made Georgia very special, and scientists were very excited. The discovery of the tooth proved that Georgia was the home of the earliest humans in Europe. The whole area was clearly very important. It was where the first humans settled after Africa. The oldest human fossils ever found were in Ethiopia, and they were around 2.8 million years old. Difficult words: skull (the bones of the head), prove (to show that something exists or is true), fossil (a very old part of an animal or plant, which people usually find in the ground). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Experts find a very old tooth. The tooth belongs to a human. This human lives 1.8 million years ago. They find the tooth in Dmanisi, Georgia. Also, archaeologists find very old skulls here. Scientists think that Georgia is the home of the oldest humans in Europe. The tooth proves the idea. Georgia is a very important place for experts. The first humans leave Africa 1.8 million years ago to go to Georgia. The tooth is the oldest human fossil in Europe. The oldest human fossil is in Africa. It is around 2.8 million years old. Difficult words: skull (the bones of the head), prove (to show that something is true), fossil (a very old part of an animal of plant, which people find in the ground). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On Thursday afternoon, the UK’s longest-serving monarch, Queen Elizabeth II, died at her Scottish estate Balmoral. After reigning for 70 years the queen died at the age of 96. Elizabeth was born on April 21, 1926, and she never expected to ascend to the throne. However, when Elizabeth’s uncle, Edward VIII, abdicated in 1936, her father George VI became the king, and she became heir to the throne. She was only 25 when she became the queen, and Winston Churchill was the first of 15 prime ministers that served with her. During her reign, 14 US presidents served. Elizabeth married Prince Phillip, and their marriage remained solid for 74 years, until his death in April 2021. The couple had four children, and Charles, born in 1948, has now become the king. Most people described Elizabeth as a dignified, down-to-earth, and witty woman whose lifelong passions, aside from her public duties, were horse racing and corgis . Difficult words: abdicate (to give up formally a throne or high office), heir (a person who’s legally entitled to something after someone’s death), corgi (a dog with short legs and a foxlike head). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Queen Elizabeth was born on April 21, 1926. She never thought that she would become a queen. When her uncle Edward VIII abdicated , her father George VI became the king. Elizabeth became the queen when she was only 25 years old, and she reigned for a long 70 years. During this time, 15 British prime ministers and 14 US presidents were leaders. Elizabeth wed Prince Phillip, and they were married for 74 years. The couple had four children; their oldest son was Charles. He just became the new British king. Elizabeth II attended thousands of public events. In her private life, she loved horse racing and her dogs. People said that she had good manners, and she was calm and witty . Difficult words: abdicate (to give up the throne to be a king or queen), reign (to be the king or queen of a country), witty (clever and funny). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Queen Elizabeth is born on April 21, 1926. Her uncle is the British king. He abdicates in 1936. Elizabeth’s father George VI becomes the new king. Elizabeth becomes the queen next. She is 25 years old. She is the queen for 70 years. She leads for the longest time for any king or queen in history. During the 70 years, 15 UK prime ministers and 14 US presidents are leaders. Elizabeth’s husband is Prince Phillip. They are married for 74 years. He dies in 2021. Elizabeth and Philip have four children. The oldest child is Charles. Queen Elizabeth dies last Thursday in Scotland. Charles becomes the new king. Difficult words: abdicate (to give up a job as a king or queen), prime minister (the leader of a government), husband (a married man). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Dashcam footage in a police vehicle shows a deer rushing into the road before the car hits it, and it dramatically flies through the air. The Kentucky, USA, officer applied the brakes, but he managed to keep the vehicle on course despite the collision. The local police department hopes that the encounter will be a lesson to everyone on what to do if you ever run into a deer. It said that although the police officer did not manage to avoid the collision, he did maintain control of his vehicle throughout the entire instant, even when the large, but apparently agile and acrobatically trained deer was performing a triple axel over the hood of his car. The police department even joked that, as it is getting closer to Christmas, it would have to check with Santa if he was not missing any helpers . The police car sustained a lot of damage from the incident, but remarkably, you can see the deer at the end of the video escaping seemingly uninjured. Difficult words: dashcam (a camera which is on the dash of a car – the flat area in front of the driver), footage (a video), rush (to move very fast), encounter (a meeting), agile (able to move well), axel (turning in the air), hood (the metal covering of the front of the car), helper (one of the reindeer that Santa uses). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A deer in Kentucky ran into the road and hit a police car. The driver started to break , but he managed to keep control of the car. This incident serves as an example of what to do if you ever run into a deer. A camera inside the car filmed the incident. You can see that the deer did a triple axel in the air. It landed back on the ground and ran away. It seemed to be fine. Difficult words: brake (to slow down), serve (to show), axel (a turn in the air). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Kentucky is a state in the USA. A police car is on a road there. A deer runs across the road. It hits the police car. The driver starts to brake . The car does not change its course . This is safe. This is a good example to people. The deer damages the car, but the deer is OK. It runs away. Difficult words: deer (a big animal which eats grass), brake (to slow down), course (the direction something moves). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A Russian court banned Novaya Gazeta from operating; it was one of the country’s few remaining independent news companies. The newspaper has online publications elsewhere in Europe, which Russian authorities have also blocked. Reportedly, Novaya Gazeta failed to provide documents that related to a change of ownership in 2006. People founded the newspaper almost 30 years ago, and it was one of Russia’s leading investigative news sources. Dmitri Muratov, the paper’s editor-in-chief, was a Nobel peace prize winner. He said the decision was a political hit job , and it had no legal basis at all. The newspaper will appeal the court’s decision; however, Muratov expects the same result. In March, Novaya Gazeta already suspended operations in Russia because it allegedly violated strict censorship laws on coverage of the war in Ukraine. Difficult words: hit job (a murder for criminal or political purposes), violate (to break a rule), censorship (when an authority limits the ideas that people are allowed to express in books, films, documents, and so on). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Novaya Gazeta is one of the few last Russian independent newspapers. It started almost 30 years ago, and it was one of the most important investigative newspapers in the country. In March, Novaya Gazeta stopped its work in Russia. Officials said that the newspaper didn’t write the truth about the war in Ukraine. Last week, a court banned Novaya Gazeta in Russia, and Russian authorities stopped its online publications in Europe. Dmitri Muratov, the newspaper’s boss, said that there was no legal reason for the ban. The court said that Novaya Gazeta didn’t have some documents from the year 2006. Novaya Gazeta will appeal against the court’s decision, but Muratov said that he didn’t expect any change. Difficult words: independent (free from outside control), investigative (find the truth and correct information), appeal (to take a court’s decision to another court for review). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section

Novaya Gazeta is a Russian newspaper. It is independent. Independent is when no government controls it. In March, Novaya Gazeta stops its work in Russia. Officials say that Novaya Gazeta doesn’t write the truth about the war in Ukraine. Last week, a court bans Novaya Gazeta in Russia. Russian officials block its work in Europe, too. Dmitri Muratov is the boss of Novaya Gazeta. He says that he doesn’t understand the ban. The court says that Novaya Gazeta doesn’t have some papers from 2006. Muratov says that the ban is political . Novaya Gazeta will ask another court to check the situation again. Muratov believes nothing will change. Difficult words: control (to have power over someone or something), ban (to officially stop something), political (something that powerful people want rather than something that is good). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Liz Truss has become Britain’s new prime minister after she won a leadership race for the governing Conservative Party. Since the 2015 election, Truss is the fourth prime minister from the party. She replaced Boris Johnson at a time when the country has a cost of living crisis, industrial and social unrest , and the ongoing war in Ukraine. In her first speech, Truss announced her plan to cut taxes and grow the British economy. She also promised to deal with long-term issues of energy supplies. The Ukraine war is hitting countries across Europe; however, Britain particularly depends on gas, and its inflation rate is higher than other major European economies. Experts say they have never seen a prime minister start in the office with such unfavorable headwinds , such as strikes everywhere from rail workers to lawyers or bin collectors. Truss will have to work hard to win the supporters of her rival and Britain’s former finance minister, Rishi Sunak. Difficult words: unrest (a state of dissatisfaction and disagreements), headwinds (conditions that stop progress), rival (a competitor). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last week, Liz Truss became Britain’s new prime minister. She beat her rival Rishi Sunak, and she became the new leader of the Conservative Party. Truss became the party’s fourth prime minister since 2015. She replaced Boris Johnson at a very difficult time when the country has many problems. Britain depends on Russian gas, and the war in Ukraine is raising the prices dramatically. The cost of living is also rising, energy prices upset many people, and many workers are on strikes in different industries. Truss promised that she would cut down taxes, and she would deal with problems with energy supplies soon. Experts said that no prime minister has started work in such a difficult situation. Difficult words: rival (a person who competes with someone), strike (a protest), cut down (to reduce). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Britain has a new prime minister . She is Liz Truss. Truss becomes the new leader of the Conservative Party. She beats Rishi Sunak. She is the fourth prime minister of the Conservative Party since 2015. Truss is in a most difficult position. The country is having many problems right now. The cost of living is very high. Energy prices are growing. Britain needs gas from Russia. Gas from Russia is very expensive because of the war in Ukraine. Truss says that she will solve the problems. She will lower taxes . She promises that she will solve the problem with energy supplies . Difficult words: prime minister (the leader of a government), tax (money which people pay to the government), supply (amount of something that people can use). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Sri Lanka is famous for its precious stones, and the biggest blue star sapphire yet has been found recently. It weighs an incredible 1404.49 carats (281 grams) and the current owner, who remained anonymous for safety reasons, claims that it could sell for up to 175 million dollars at auction. The gem’s name is Sapphire the Star of Adam, after a Muslim belief that Adam came from the Garden of Eden and arrived in Sri Lanka, where the tears that he shed while seeking God’s forgiveness turned into gems. Difficult words: star sapphire (a sapphire which reflects a star-like image), claim (when people say something that may or may not be true), shed (let drop). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Sri Lanka is famous for its precious stones, and a person recently discovered the world’s largest blue star sapphire there. The sapphire weighs 1404.49 carats, and it could sell for up to 175 million dollars at auction. The owner is a Sri Lankan businessman. The sapphire’s name is Sapphire the Star of Adam after a Muslim belief that God sent Adam from the Garden of Eden and he arrived in Sri Lanka. His tears turned into precious stones. Difficult words: precious (special, worth a lot of money), star sapphire (a sapphire which reflects a starlike image), owner (a person who owns – has something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Sri Lanka is famous for its precious stones. A man finds a blue sapphire there. It is 1404.49 carats heavy. It can sell for up to 175 million dollars at auction. A Sri Lankan businessman now owns the sapphire. The sapphire has a name. People call it the “Sapphire the Star of Adam”. It is named after a Muslim belief . Difficult words: precious (special, expensive), own (to have), belief (something that you think is true). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In Prague, the Czech Republic, an estimated 70,000 people protested against the government. Protesters called on the coalition in power to control the soaring energy prices, and they voiced opposition to the EU and NATO. Organizers of the demonstration from a number of far-right and fringe political groups, including the Communist party, said that the country should have a neutral military. They also said it should ensure direct contracts with gas suppliers, including Russia. The city center protest happened a day after the government survived a no-confidence vote amid opposition claims of inaction against inflation and energy prices. One of the event co-organizers said if the government didn’t solve the issue of electricity and gas prices, it would destroy the Czech economy in autumn. Difficult words: far-right (having extreme or nationalistic political views), fringe (extreme or unusual), no-confidence vote (a formal vote where people indicate they no longer support a leader or government). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last weekend, around 70,000 people protested about the government in the streets of Prague, the Czech Republic. People were angry with the situation about the rise prices of energy, especially gas and electricity. The protest organizers belonged to several political groups, including people with extreme and nationalistic political ideas. Leaders of the Communist party were worry there. Many people agreed that the Czech Republic shouldn’t be part of the EU and NATO, and it should be neutral during war. The protesters also said that if the government didn’t lower the prices of energies, they would have a negative change on Czech business in autumn. Difficult words: extreme (very great or unusual), nationalistic (pride and support in a country), neutral (when a person or country doesn’t support either side in a conflict). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Last week, people protest in the center of Prague, the Czech Republic. Around 70,000 people meet at the main square. They protest against the Czech government. The prices are going up for electricity, gas, and many other things. People are angry about the change. Leaders of extremist and nationalist groups are at the protest. Leaders of the Communist party are there, too. These people say that the Czech Republic must be a neutral country in a war. They also say that is not good that the country belongs to the EU and NATO. Organizers of the protests say that the government must do something with the high prices of energies. If not, the prices will hurt will business in autumn. Difficult words: extremist (a person with strong and unusual political ideas), nationalist (a person who loves his country, and he thinks that it is better than other countries), neutral (when a person or country doesn’t support either side in a difficult situation). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Scientists say that people can possibly produce oxygen on Mars with a device called MOXIE. MOXIE is a prototype of a small engine that produces oxygen out of thin air. It touched down on Mars with NASA’s Perseverance rover in 2021, and it’s now operating routinely in a variety of atmospheric conditions, including during the day and night, and through different Martian seasons. The device is necessary for future astronauts to breathe there. Thin air on Mars has carbon dioxide, and MOXIE can produce 5.6 grams of oxygen an hour, which is about the same as a modest tree on Earth. Scientists are hoping to scale up the device, so it can produce oxygen at the rate of several hundred trees. 25 tons of oxygen are needed to lift four astronauts off the surface of Mars. People could bring the oxygen from Earth, but it would be too expensive and not sustainable in the long term. MOXIE is a major step in living off the land when people go to Mars. Difficult words: prototype (a first version of a device or vehicle), routine (as part of a regular procedure rather than for a special reason), scale up (to increase something in size, amount, or production). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

When NASA’s Perseverance rover landed on Mars in 2021, it carried a device called MOXIE. MOXIE is a small engine which can make oxygen out of carbon dioxide . When astronauts are on Mars in the future, they will need oxygen to breathe. It is possible to bring oxygen from Earth, but it would be too expensive and not sustainable . MOXIE is currently working on Mars in different Martian seasons and parts of the day. It can make 5.6 grams of oxygen an hour. This amount is the same which a small tree makes. Scientists hope that one day, MOXIE will make much more oxygen. Astronauts will need 25 tons of oxygen to lift off from Mars. Difficult words: rover (a vehicle to drive in difficult terrain), carbon dioxide (a colorless gas which is a part of air), sustainable (something that can continue for a long time). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

NASA’s Perseverance rover lands on Mars in 2021. It carries a small device . The device is called MOXIE. No oxygen is on Mars. Future astronauts need oxygen to breathe. MOXIE has a special job. It makes oxygen out of carbon dioxide . MOXIE makes 5.6 grams of oxygen in one hour. It is not very much. A small tree makes as much oxygen. Astronauts will need tons of oxygen. MOXIE must make a lot of oxygen. People can bring oxygen from Earth. Sadly, it costs too much money. Also, it is not possible to do it for a long time. Difficult words: device (a small object or machine which does a specific job), oxygen (a gas which people need to breathe to live), carbon dioxide (a gas which is a part of air, and plants change it to oxygen). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In the 1960s, the average American’s life expectancy was almost 70 years old, and the US ranked 18 th in the world. Today, the country’s average life expectancy is 77 years old; however, other countries made more progress in expectancy. In 2020, the US ranked 61 st out of 237 nations. After World War II and the postwar boom , Americans benefited from medical advances like penicillin and open-heart surgery. As the 20 th century progressed, Americans lived longer, but they also developed unhealthy habits. The diet started to rely on prepared foods that we commonly call junk food. More people got involved in work, and they did less exercise. Nowadays, many people are lacking a health care system, and they don’t take preventive actions early enough to deal with illnesses. In the last 30 years, the use of opiates has reached an epidemic level, and obesity has gotten much higher, too. Difficult words: life expectancy (the number of year a person can expect to live), boom (a period of prosperity or economic growth), opiate (a drug that treats pain or causes sleepiness). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

After World War II, the US was in a good situation, and its economy grew. In the 1960s, the average American lived almost 70 years, and the US ranked 18 th in the world in life expectancy . In 2020, the US ranked 61 st in life expectancy out of 237 nations, so the situation of other nations improved. Today, the country’s life expectancy is 77 years old, which is 7 years more than 60 years ago. Experts believe that many things influence why Americans don’t live as long as other nations’s peoples. Since World War II, Americans benefited from modern medicine. At the same time, they started to work more, exercise less, and eat unhealthy food. American health care isn’t as good as in other countries, and many people don’t do check-ups. They often wait to visit a doctor until they are seriously ill. Difficult words: rank (to be on a place within a system), life expectancy (how long a person expects to live), benefit (to get something good from a situation or thing). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The time after World War II is good for the US. It is a good time for business. Life expectancy is a number that tells how long someone expects to live. In the 1960s, the life expectancy in the US is 70 years old. This is the 18 th highest number in the world. In 2020, the life expectancy is 77 years old. Now, the country is 61 st in the world. Americans live longer than in the past. Many other nations live longer than Americans. Many reasons explain the change. Since World War II, people work more. They do less sports. They eat unhealthy food. Many people don’t go to the doctor regularly. They only go when they don’t feel good. Sometimes their situation is too late for help. Difficult words: nation (people who live in the same area or country), reason (why something happens), unhealthy (something that is not good for the body). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

People from around the world pasted each other with tomatoes during Spain’s famous La Tomatina street tomato fight. Last week, the festival happened in the town of Buñol which is a tomato-producing region. A two-year suspension delayed the festival because of the coronavirus pandemic, and this year’s festival had added incentives . It was the 75 th anniversary and 20 years since Spain declared it as an international tourist attraction. Up to 20,000 people were in the festival; a 1945 food fight between local children in the town inspired the event. People on trucks unloaded 130 tons of over-ripe tomatoes along the main street of the town for participants, who crammed below. Many people wore swimming goggles to protect their eyes, and after the hour-long battle, their clothes were covered in pulp , just like the whole area. Difficult words: paste (to cover), incentive (something that encourages people to work or do an activity), pulp (a soft, wet mass of material). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

La Tomatina festival happens in Buñol, a town in Eastern Spain; the area is a good place to grow tomatoes. At the festival, people throw over- ripe tomatoes at each other, and it is a popular attraction for tourists, too. In 1945, children started a food fight in the streets of Buñol, and La Tomatina started there. In the 1980s, the festival became so popular that people from every corner of the world came to see. Last week, about 20,000 people took part in La Tomatina, and they threw 130 tons of tomatoes at each other. Some people wore goggles to protect their eyes. The fight lasted one hour, and when it ended, everyone was covered with tomatoes, and the main street was red. Difficult words: attraction (a place or event which many people come to see), ripe (fruit that is ready to eat), goggles (special glasses to protect the eyes from chemicals, water, snow, and so on). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

La Tomatina is a festival . It takes place in Buñol. Buñol is a town in Eastern Spain. This area is known for farms of tomatoes. In 1945, children in Buñol have a food fight in the street. Then La Tomatina starts. People have a big tomato fight every year. The festival becomes very popular in the 1980s. People from all the world come to see it. Last week, about 20,000 people are in La Tomatina. They throw 130 tons of tomatoes at each other. Some people wear goggles . Goggles keep their eyes safe. When the fight ends, all the people are red from the tomatoes. The streets are red, too. Difficult words: festival (an event, during which people celebrate something), popular (when many people like someone or something), goggles (special glasses which keep the eyes safe from water, snow, and other things). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A man with a gun threatened Argentina’s vice-president Cristina Fernández de Kircher while she was greeting supporters outside her home in Buenos Aires. The attacker aimed at the vice-president, and he pulled the trigger . However, the weapon that had five bullets didn’t fire, so she wasn’t injured. After the incident, the Argentinian president Alberto Fernández said that the attack was the most serious event that the country went through since it returned to democracy. He declared the day after the attack a national holiday, so the Argentinian people could express themselves in peace and harmony to defend life. Hundreds of thousands of people gathered at the capital’s main plaza to show solidarity against the attack. Difficult words: vice-president (an officer that serves as a president in the president’s absence), trigger (a mechanism that fires a gun when it’s released), solidarity (a feeling of unity and support among people). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In Buenos Aires, a man attacked Argentina’s vice-president Christina Fernández de Kircher outside her home. Fernández de Kircher was meeting with her supporters , when suddenly, a man pointed a gun at her. He pulled the trigger , but luckily, the gun didn’t fire. Nothing happened to the vice-president. Later, officials said that five bullets were in the gun. The Argentinian president said that the attack was so serious that he called the next day a national holiday. Hundreds of thousands of people met in the center of Buenos Aires to show support for the vice-president. Difficult words: vice-president (a person who does the president’s job when he can’t do it), supporter (a person who agrees with someone’s ideas or opinions), trigger (a part of a gun which makes it fire a bullet). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Christina Fernández de Kircher is the vice-president of Argentina. Last week, many people greet her in front of her house in Buenos Aires. She speaks to them. She is smiling at them. Suddenly, a man points a gun at Fernández de Kircher. He wants to shoot. Luckily, the gun doesn’t work properly. Nothing happens to the vice-president. Officials later say that five bullets are in the gun. The Argentinian president speaks on TV. He says that the attack is very serious. He calls the next day a national holiday. Thousands of people meet in the center of Buenos Aires. They show support to the vice-president. Difficult words: vice-president (a person who works as a president when the president cannot work), bullet (a small metal object which is inside a gun), support (to help someone be strong). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A security camera footage shows a car owner walking to pay at a service station in Darwin, Australia, before a figure appears from the shadows, gets into the car and starts to drive off. However, the unsuspecting thief was stopped in his tracks by the courageous owner who launched himself feet first through the passenger side window and got inside the car. Later, the thief is running off into the distance, presumably quite startled by the turn of events . Difficult words: footage (a video), unsuspecting (not knowing about the danger), startled (shocked), the turn of events (when things suddenly change). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In Australia, a driver was at a petrol station. When he walked away from his car to pay, a person got into his car and tried to drive off . The driver wanted to stop the thief , so he launched himself feet first through the passenger side window. He did a ninja jump! The jump scared the thief and he ran away. He is now wanted by the police. Difficult words: drive off (to drive quickly away), thief (somebody who steals things), launch oneself (to make a quick, energetic movement to attack). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

This happens in Australia. A driver is at a petrol station. He fills his car. He walks away to pay. A thief enters his car. He wants to steal it. The driver wants to stop the thief. He starts to run. He jumps into the window of the car. This scares the thief. He runs away. Police are looking for the thief. Difficult words: fill (to put petrol in), thief (a person who steals things), steal (to take things which are not yours). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In Catalonia, Spain, on Tuesday, a 20-month-old girl died from head trauma from a large hailstone with a diameter of about 11 centimeters. The toddler went to a hospital in the Girona capital; however, she died of her injuries hours later. Fierce storms hit the north of the region with the largest hailstones seen in two decades; they injured people, destroyed roofs, and downed power cables. About 50 people reported injuries of bruises and bone fractures . According to officials, the hailstones fell only for about 10 terrifying minutes. Hailstorms occur throughout the year; however, they happen most frequently between March and September. An unusually hot summer warmed the nearby Mediterranean Sea, and it made more violent tropical storms. Difficult words: diameter (the length of a straight line through a round object), fierce (very strong and wild), fracture (a break in something, especially a bone). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last week, heavy storms hit the north of Catalonia, Spain. Large hailstones injured about 50 people, and they killed a small girl. A hailstone hit the 20-month-old girl on the head. She went to hospital, but she died some hours later. People reported head injuries, bruises, and broken bones. Storms also damaged houses, windows and electricity cables. The hailstones were as big as a fist ; they were the biggest in the last 20 years. Scientists said that hailstorms happen all year, but they happen most often between March and September. A very hot summer warmed the Mediterranean Sea more than usual, and storms were heavier. Difficult words: hailstone (a hard ball of ice, which falls from the sky), bruise (a blue mark on the skin, which usually appears when you hit something), fist (a hand with its fingers closed tightly in). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Last week, heavy storms hit Catalonia, Spain. Hailstones hurt about 50 people. They hit people’s head, break their bones, and they make bruises . Hailstones kill a girl. She is 20 months old. She dies in a hospital. Officials say that the event is a tragedy . The storm lasts only about 10 minutes. It is still very dangerous. It damages cars and roads. The hailstones are very big. They are more than 10 centimeters big. Hailstones usually fall between March and September. This year’s summer is very hot. The Mediterranean Sea is warmer than usual. More and worse storms happen. Difficult words: hailstone (a hard ball of ice, which falls from the sky), bruise (a blue mark on the skin), tragedy (a very bad and sad situation). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A goat intended to be lunch for a tiger at a Russian safari park not only survived but amazingly became the big cat’s friend. They are now inseparable ; wherever Amur goes, so does Timur. Staff at the Russian safari park was stunned when the unlikely bond formed between Amur the tiger and the goat which they named Timur, meaning ‘iron’ because of his bravery. The Siberian tiger even had to sleep outside of his hut once, as the cheeky goat stole his new friend’s bed. Keepers said that the tiger was quite lazy by nature, so he has not gone to the trouble of hunting the goat. For the goat’s sake, let’s hope that Amur does not get hungry! Difficult words: intended (planned or meant), inseparable (very close), stunned (surprised), bond (a relationship), hut (a small simple “house”), cheeky (rude). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

People put a goat into the enclosure of a Siberian tiger at a Russian zoo. They intended the goat to be the tiger’s lunch, but it became the tiger’s friend instead! Because of its bravery , the zookeepers named the goat Timur which means “iron”. Timur follows the tiger around and even sleeps in its house. The zookeepers said that the tiger is quite lazy – so lazy that it didn’t hunt the goat. Let’s just hope that the tiger doesn’t get hungry! Difficult words: enclosure (an area surrounded by a wall), intended (planned), bravery (being brave – not afraid). You can read the original story and watch the video in the Level 3 section.

This news is from a Russian zoo. It is about a Siberian tiger and a goat. People give the tiger the goat. The goat is for the tiger’s food. However, the tiger does not eat the goat. The goat becomes the tiger’s friend. It follows the tiger everywhere. It even sleeps in the tiger’s house! The goat is brave . People name it Timur. Timur means “iron”. Why didn’t the tiger eat the goat? It is too lazy to hunt it! Difficult words: brave (not afraid), lazy (if you are lazy, you do not want to do anything), hunt (to catch and to kill). You can read the original story and watch the video in the Level 3 section.

Since mid June, record floods in Pakistan killed over 1,150 people. Weeks of unprecedented monsoon rains caused the floods. On Tuesday, the United Nations and Pakistan issued an appeal for 160-million-dollar emergency funding to help millions of people affected by the floods. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres also said that the floods signalled to the world to step up action against climate change. The floods left millions of people are homeless. They destroyed schools, health facilities and critical services. Every province of the country has been affected, and Guterres asked the UN to respond quickly to the crisis. Difficult words: unprecedented (never done or known before), monsoon (winds and heavy rain in South Asia from May to September), step up (to make something more effective). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Monsoon winds bring rain to Southern Asia every year, but this year’s rains were heavier than ever before. Since June, floods hit all parts of Pakistan. Over 1,150 people died, and floods destroyed millions of homes, schools, hospitals, and important infrastructure . Many people believed that the floods were the result of the climate change . Antonio Guterres, the UN Secretary-General spoke to world leaders last week. Guterres said that all the world must work together to solve the climate crisis . Pakistan also asked the UN for 160 million dollars to help people affected by the disaster. Difficult words: infrastructure (the system and services in a country, for example, roads or power supply), climate change (a change in the usual weather on the planet), climate crisis (dangerous changes in weather on the planet). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A monsoon is a wind. It brings rain to Southern Asia. It happens every year from May to September. This year’s rain is much heavier than usual. Floods happen in all parts of Pakistan. Millions of people lose their homes. They have nowhere to go. 1,150 people die. Water destroys homes, roads, and the power supply . Pakistan asks the UN for help. The country needs 160 million dollars. Antonio Guterres is the UN leader. He speaks to world leaders last week. He says that the floods happen because of climate crisis . All the world must do something quickly. Difficult words: floods (when water goes into people’s homes and on roads), power supply (large cables which bring electricity to buildings), climate crisis (dangerous changes in the weather on our planet). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

NASA released an audio clip of a black hole’s actual sound waves. These sound waves emanate from the enormous black hole at the center of the Perseus galaxy cluster. Pressure waves from the black hole caused ripples in the cluster’s hot gas, and scientists were able to translate them into a sound or note. According to NASA, the misconception originated that no sound is in space because most of space is a vacuum where sound waves cannot travel. However, the Perseus galaxy cluster has so much gas that scientists found sound. They amplified and mixed it with other data to hear the black hole. Difficult words: emanate (to originate from), ripple (a small wave or movement of a surface), amplify (to increase the volume of sound). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

NASA released an audio clip in which we can hear the sound of a black hole. The sound came from the center of the Perseus galaxy cluster , where a huge black hole sent pressure waves . These waves made hot gas in the cluster move. Scientists then transferred this movement into a sound, which they made louder and mixed with other data. The result was the actual sound of the black hole. Many people thought that sound didn’t travel in space because space is mostly a vacuum . So much gas is in the Perseus galaxy that scientists were able to hear the sound. Difficult words: galaxy cluster (thousands of galaxies), pressure wave (a wave which moves in the air when something explodes), vacuum (empty of gas, liquids, or solids). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

For the first time ever, we can listen to the sound of a black hole . A very big black hole is in the center of the Perseus galaxy . The galaxy is a part of the Perseus galaxy cluster . Thousands of galaxies are in the cluster. A lot of gas is there. Normally, we cannot hear sound in space. Sound needs air to travel. No air is in space. Interestingly, the black hole makes the gas move. Scientists can read the sound from the moving gas. Scientists make the sound louder. They mix it with other information. The result is the real sound of the black hole. Difficult words: black hole (a place in space where nothing can get out), galaxy (millions of stars and gas), cluster (a group of similar things which are close together). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.
